- scripts/build_static_context.sh:380-415 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The embedded `fragment_lines()` parser in `emit_agents_index` copies only the SECTION_MARKER, FENCE and H2 regexes from scripts/assemble_agents.py and none of the `parse_fragment()` rejection rules (scripts/assemble_agents.py:138-185): no_marker, content_before_marker, malformed_marker, heading_in_block, unclosed_fence, empty_block, empty_section_name and generated_section. As a result, rejected fragments are still listed, for example "- agents.d/c-nomarker.md: section=(none)" (line 412).
  WHY: The issue requires "Treat any parse failure as 'no fragments listed'", but the index heading at line 442 tells the model that fragments will be "appended to the named sections at release time". The release fold (FragmentError) and the inline path (_static_context_cat_agents, lines 107-116) both reject these fragments, and the test test_agents_d_fragments_listed_with_sections (tests/test_static_context_agents_index.py:159-180) locks in the wrong behaviour. All reviewers rated it MAJOR.
- scripts/build_static_context.sh:440-460 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The cap loop has two faults. `total_items` (line 448) and `printed_items` count fragment entries as items, and the stop condition at line 452 matches only kind == "item". With 300 or more headings, the "Pending agents.d/ fragments ..." note is printed and the loop then breaks before the first fragment, leaving the header empty. The "... (N more headings)" message at line 460 also overstates the number of omitted headings.
  WHY: The index text is misleading or cosmetically wrong whenever the item cap or byte cap fires at or inside the fragment block. The safety caps still hold, and this repo's agents.md is far below 300 headings today. All reviewers rated it NIT.
- tests/test_agents_fragment_contract.py:(no line; "Test suite failure (CI integration)") | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: Adding the agents-index phase caused regression failures in the existing contract test suite.
  WHY: The CI job tests-hooks-and-orchestrator will fail and block the PR merge because of contract violations in how fragments or agents.md are handled or expected.

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/build_static_context.sh:397-413 (emit_agents_index, embedded Python fragment_lines(); label at line 412; fallback at lines 419-423) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The index uses a looser fragment grammar than scripts/assemble_agents.py parse_fragment() (lines 138-185) and skips the rules no_marker (177), content_before_marker (164), malformed_marker (161), heading_in_block (168), unclosed_fence (175), empty_block (184) and generated_section (157). Only a UTF-8 decode error or an OSError reaches the "fragments = []" fallback. As a result, a no-marker, heading-in-block or "Repo-tree (auto-generated)" fragment is listed under the line-442 "appended to the named sections at release time" claim.
  WHY: The issue says "Treat any parse failure as 'no fragments listed'", but the release fold and the inline path (_static_context_cat_agents, lines 107-116) both drop these fragments. test_agents_d_fragments_listed_with_sections pins "- agents.d/c-nomarker.md: section=(none)", and index is the default mode for later phases. Fix: raise in fragment_lines() on no marker, text before the first marker, or a fence still open at EOF, then update the c-nomarker expectation.
- scripts/build_static_context.sh:440-460 (total_items at line 448, stop test at line 452, emit at line 460) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: With 300 or more headings and at least one fragment, the "Pending agents.d/ fragments ..." note prints and then has no entries under it. The "(N more headings)" count includes fragment entries.
  WHY: The closing message is wrong and the fragment header is empty whenever the item or byte cap fires at or after the fragment block. The caps still hold, so the impact is message accuracy only.
- TASK GAPS: NONE. The six pass-1 TASK_GAP entries are not gaps, because the list is "advisory" and ci.yml line 2437 wires the new test. The test_review_pr_tree_python_isolation.py regex at line 187 does not match "python3 -I -B -", and the other tests check behaviour the diff does not change. The pass-1 tests/test_agents_fragment_contract.py finding was dropped because it does not map to any hunk.
- HARDENING: scripts/build_static_context.sh _static_context_agents_mode, line 289. The `tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]'` call is locale-dependent; use LC_ALL=C (1 line). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1

- scripts/build_static_context.sh:lines 380-414, specifically the body of `fragment_lines()` inside `emit_agents_index` | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `fragment_lines()` copies only the SECTION_MARKER, FENCE and H2 regexes and omits every rejection rule in `parse_fragment()` (scripts/assemble_agents.py:138-185): no_marker, content_before_marker, malformed_marker, heading_in_block, unclosed_fence, empty_block, empty_section_name and generated_section. It therefore lists no-marker fragments (`section=(none)`, line 412), fragments with text before the first marker, heading-in-block fragments, unclosed-fence fragments and generated-section fragments.
  WHY: The inline path (`_static_context_cat_agents`, lines 107-116) and the release fold both reject these fragments, so the model is wrongly told they will be appended. test_agents_d_fragments_listed_with_sections (tests/test_static_context_agents_index.py:159-180) locks the behaviour in, and the issue requires "Treat any parse failure as 'no fragments listed'."
- scripts/build_static_context.sh:lines 440-460 (the queue build, the loop condition at line 452, and the cap-line emit at line 460) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The stop condition matches only "item" entries. After 300 headings the "Pending agents.d/ fragments ..." note still prints and the loop breaks on the first fragment. `total_items` (line 448) and `printed_items` (line 457) count fragments, so line 460 mislabels the omitted count as "more headings".
  WHY: When agents.md has more than 300 headings, the output has a dangling fragments header with no entries. With oversized fragment entries, the cap line also mislabels the omitted count.
